tool.name: selscan norm
tool.description: Normalize selscan scores and generate windowed summaries
tool.command: ln -s '$in_file' input.out && selscan norm #if $norm_stat == 'ihs' --ihs #elif $norm_stat == 'nsl' --nsl #elif $norm_stat == 'xpehh' --xpehh #elif $norm_stat == 'xpnsl' --xpnsl #end if --files input.out --crit-val $crit_val #if $crit_percent --crit-percent $crit_percent #end if --qbins $qbins #if $norm_stat == 'ihs' or $norm_stat == 'nsl' --bins $bins #end if #if $window_analysis['do_windows'] == 'yes' --bp-win --winsize $window_analysis.winsize --min-snps $window_analysis.min_snps #end if --log norm.log && #set $norm_suffix = '.norm' #if $norm_stat == 'ihs' or $norm_stat == 'nsl' #set $norm_suffix = '.' + str($bins) + 'bins.norm' #end if #if $window_analysis['do_windows'] == 'yes' mv 'input.out${norm_suffix}.${str(int($window_analysis.winsize) // 1000)}kb.windows' '$windows_file' && #end if mv 'input.out${norm_suffix}' '$norm_file'

param.name: in_file
param.label: selscan score file (.out)
param.help: The tab-delimited score file produced by the selscan tool for the selected statistic.

param.name: crit_val
param.label: Critical value
param.help: The absolute normalized score threshold used to flag extreme (candidate) SNPs. A SNP is flagged if its normalized score is above this value or below its negative.

param.name: crit_percent
param.label: Critical percentile
param.help: If set, the critical value is instead computed as the (1 - p/2) and (p/2) quantiles of the sorted normalized scores. Overrides the critical value.

param.name: qbins
param.label: Quantile bins
param.help: Outlying windows are binned by the number of sites within each window. This is the number of quantile bins to use.

param.name: bins
param.label: Frequency bins
param.help: The number of frequency bins in [0,1] for score normalization. Only used for iHS and nSL.

param.name: do_windows
param.label: Generate windowed summary
param.help: Analyze non-overlapping windows of fixed bp for extreme scores, producing a .windows file.

param.name: winsize
param.label: Window size (bp)
param.help: The non-overlapping window size for calculating the percentage of extreme SNPs.

param.name: min_snps
param.label: Minimum SNPs per window
param.help: Only consider a bp window if it has at least this many SNPs.

tool.help:
**What it does**
The `selscan norm` subcommand standardizes the unstandardized iHS, nSL, XP-EHH and XP-nSL scores produced by the **selscan** tool, and can optionally generate windowed summaries of extreme scores.
**Normalization**
- **iHS / nSL** — scores are binned by derived allele frequency into `bins` frequency bins in [0,1]. Within each bin the mean and variance are computed, and each score is standardized as `(x - mean) / sqrt(variance)`. Only bins containing at least 20 SNPs are reported. The **Frequency bins** parameter only applies to iHS and nSL. - **XP-EHH / XP-nSL** — scores are standardized using a single bin (the whole genome).
A SNP is flagged as a candidate (the `crit` column is set to 1) if its normalized score is at or above the critical value, or at or below its negative. If a critical percentile is given, the critical value is instead computed from the quantiles of the sorted scores.
**Windowed summary**
When window analysis is enabled, the normalized scores are summarized in non-overlapping windows of the given size. For each window the fraction of extreme SNPs and a percentile score are reported. Windows with fewer than the minimum number of SNPs are reported with a percentile of -1 and a score of NA.
**Input**
A tab-delimited score file produced by the **selscan** tool for the selected statistic. The file must contain the header line and chromosome column produced by selscan v3.0.0+.
